steps.caption: Messages
steps.narration: Messages keeps every client conversation in one place. Here is how to answer one.

steps.caption: Threads
steps.narration: There is one thread per client, with the newest on top.

steps.caption: Unread
steps.narration: A number on a thread means a message is waiting for you.

steps.caption: Open the thread
steps.narration: Click the thread to open it.

steps.caption: The client's message
steps.narration: Luis is asking about a lighter oak colour.

steps.value: Yes. I will bring three lighter oak samples to our next visit.
steps.caption: Reply
steps.narration: Type your reply in the box under the conversation.

steps.caption: Reply sent
steps.narration: Your reply is in his client portal, and a copy went to his email.

steps.caption: Client activity
steps.narration: The Client activity tab shows what your clients are doing.

steps.caption: Activity feed
steps.narration: Payments are listed here, newest first.

steps.caption: Messages tab
steps.narration: Choose Messages to go back to the threads.

steps.caption: Menu: Messages
steps.narration: You'll find Messages in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to answer client messages | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of Messages in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will open a thread with an unread message, reply to the client, and look at the Client activity tab.
